raw_response:
The figure consists of two line plots, arranged vertically, both illustrating training rewards as a function of steps. Both plots share a common x-axis labeled "Steps", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500 and tick labels at intervals of 100. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.4 for the top plot and 0 to 0.2 for the bottom plot, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1.

The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set", displays three lines. A blue line, labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Easy", begins at approximately (0, 0.18) and generally increases to approximately (500, 0.32), exhibiting fluctuations throughout. A red line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Easy", starts at approximately (0, 0.05) and increases to approximately (500, 0.30), also with fluctuations. A shaded region surrounds each line, indicating variability.

The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set", also displays three lines. A blue line, labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Hard", starts at approximately (0, 0.02) and increases to approximately (500, 0.15), with considerable fluctuations. A red line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Hard", begins at approximately (0, 0.03) and increases to approximately (500, 0.20), also with fluctuations. A shaded region surrounds each line, indicating variability.
